opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "Hence, approval of the shareholders is being sought for the said Related Party Transactions proposed to be entered into by your Company with Narbada Gems and Jewellery Limited (NGJL) and Sanghi Jewellers Private Limited (SJPL) for a period of 12 months..." (annual report - 2025-03-31) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: The company enjoys a cash credit limit of INR 150 million from Kotak Mahindra Bank.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "UJIL enjoys a cash credit limit of INR 150 Million from Kotak Mahindra Bank." (concall ppt - 2024-04-01)

opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "In order to conserve resources for further expanding business of the Company, your directors have opined not to recommend any dividend for the year under review." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
